voting.waitingOthers: Waiting for other players to vote...

impostorGuess.title: Guess the secret word
impostorGuess.lastChance: One last chance: guess the word to win, or skip to give up.
impostorGuess.waitingFinalGuess: The Inkpostor was eliminated and is making a final guess...

canvas.youAreInkpostor: You are the Inkpostor! Try to blend in.
canvas.emergencyVotingPrompt: Do you want to start an emergency voting?
canvas.kickConfirmationText: Are you sure you want to vote to kick {{name}}?

wordSelection.title: Write Your Word
wordSelection.description: One of the words written by the players will be the secret word. Choose something drawable!
wordSelection.descriptionSpoken: One of the words written by the players will be the secret word. Choose something easy to describe out loud!
wordSelection.hint: Once confirmed you cannot change it.
wordSelection.waitingPlayers: {{count}} of {{total}} players have written their word

roleReveal.makeSure: Make sure everyone knows their role before continuing.
roleReveal.waitingPlayers: {{count}} of {{total}} players have revealed their role

wordReveal.title: New Word
wordReveal.impostorNoWord: You still don't get the word
wordReveal.waitingPlayers: {{count}} of {{total}} players have seen the new word

orderInfo.title: Who Starts
orderInfo.youDecideRest: You decide the rest of the order
orderInfo.followOrder: Say your word in this order
orderInfo.sayOneWord: Each player says one word related to the secret word.

objective.title: Objective
objective.description: Find out who the impostor is… or fool everyone if it's you.

setup.title: Setup
setup.item1: Each player receives a secret word.
setup.item2: All players get the same word, except the impostor.
setup.item3: The impostor receives only a related hint, not the exact word.

drawing.title: Drawing Turns
drawing.item1: The game is played in turns.
drawing.item2: In each turn, each player draws a part of the word.
drawing.item3: The drawing is shared: everyone contributes to the same canvas.

observe.title: Observe & Deduce
observe.item1: While drawing, try to figure out who doesn't know the word.
observe.item2: The impostor must draw carefully to avoid suspicion.

voting.title: Voting Phase
voting.description: At the end of the round:
voting.item1: Players can vote to eliminate someone or skip the vote.
voting.item2: If a player gets the majority of votes, they are eliminated.

end.title: End of the Game
end.item1: If the impostor is caught → the players win.
end.item2: If the impostor survives → the impostor wins.

tip.title: Tip
tip.description: Draw enough to show you know the word… but don't make it too obvious

endGame.title: Do you want to end the game?
endGame.description: If you end the game now, the impostor will be revealed and the game will end for all players.

exitGame.title: Exit Game
exitGame.description: Are you sure you want to leave the room and exit the game?

gameMode.title: Game Mode
gameMode.description: Swipe to choose how the secret word is picked. Applied instantly.

classic.name: Classic
classic.description: The word is drawn at random from the Inkpostor word list.

customWord.name: Chaos
customWord.description: Every player writes a word before the game starts and one of them becomes the secret word.

hotWord.name: Hot Word
hotWord.description: A new word every round, drawn from the Inkpostor word list. The Inkpostor stays the same.

original.name: Original
original.description: The classic in-person game: nobody draws, players say one word out loud in turn.

originalChaos.name: Original + Chaos
originalChaos.description: The in-person game, but the secret word is one the players write before starting.

impostorCount.title: Inkpostors
impostorCount.description: Set the number of Inkpostors in the game.

revealTeammates.title: Reveal Teammate Inkpostors
revealTeammates.description: Show Inkpostors who their fellow Inkpostors are during role reveal.

time.title: Drawing Time per Round
time.description: Set how long each drawing round lasts.

limitInk.title: Unlimited Ink
limitInk.description: Players will have unlimited ink for drawing.

playerColors.title: Player Colors
playerColors.description: Turn off the color palette: everyone draws in their own player color.

clearCanvas.title: Clear Canvas Each Round
clearCanvas.description: Choose whether the canvas resets when a new round starts.

impostorGuess.title: Impostor Can Guess
impostorGuess.description: Let the impostor guess the secret word to win. Caught with an attempt left, they get one last try.

loseWhenOutOfGuesses.title: Lose on the last attempt
loseWhenOutOfGuesses.description: The game ends with the impostor defeated as soon as they use up every attempt.
loseWhenOutOfGuesses.toggle: Toggle losing on the last attempt

reset.label: Reset
reset.toggle: Reset every option to its default

hideHint.title: Hide the Hint
hideHint.description: The Inkpostor doesn't even get the category — they walk in blind.

turnOrder.title: Turn Order
turnOrder.description: How much of the speaking order the game hands out.
turnOrder.randomStarterHint: The first player is drawn; you decide the rest of the order.
turnOrder.fixedOrderHint: The full order is drawn once and kept every round.
turnOrder.randomOrderHint: The full order is drawn again on every round.
